name: Santosh Higher Primary School
tagline: Encouraging analytical reasoning and collaborative projects
description: The middle school years bridge basic literacy with formal scientific inquiry. Students conduct introductory laboratory observations, participate in debates, explore computer applications, and discover historical narratives.
highlights: Well-equipped science and math learning aids

features.title: Introductory Science & Computer Labs
features.detail: Hands-on access to our multimedia computer laboratory and science apparatus gives theoretical lessons direct physical meaning.

features.title: Structured Reading in Campus Library
features.detail: Scheduled weekly library hours expose students to fiction, science periodicals, and historical literature to build lifelong reading habits.

features.title: Co-Curricular Competitions & Arts
features.detail: Drawing, crafts, music, and elocution contests help young adolescents discover creative strengths beyond exams.

features.title: Continuous Assessment & Mentorship
features.detail: Monthly academic tests identify learning gaps early, supported by focused remedial assistance from subject teachers.
